WHY BARE SPECIFIERS AND NOT `npm:` INLINE. The email templates under
_shared/emails are rendered by Deno in production AND by vitest in CI

Node, so the templates would be deployable and untestable. Mapping the
bare name here lets one file satisfy both resolvers, and the versions
below are pinned to the same ones package.json installs.
